svg.title: Potential energy stored in a stretched spring
svg.desc: (a) An undeformed spring attached to a wall stores no potential energy. (b) The spring stretched a distance x from its unstretched position 0 by a force F = kx; the work done is W = ½kx², stored as PEs = ½kx². (c) A graph of F versus x is a straight line through the origin with slope k. The area under it from 0 to x is a triangle with base x and height kx, so Area = ½kx².
